The Aureum Full Moon Maple, also known as the Full Moon Japanese Maple, is a stunning tree renowned for its unique golden-yellow foliage and graceful, rounded shape. Typically reaching heights of 3 to 4 meters, the Aureum Full Moon Maple is perfect for medium to large gardens or as a specimen tree. At Herter Nursery, we offer healthy, robust AureumFull Moon Maples for sale to bring a vibrant pop of colour and a unique form to your outdoor space.
